task_description: Fix Android TV / Google TV remote navigation (D-pad does nothing, no focus visible), fix video player controls not appearing on TV (CC/subtitle/settings buttons invisible), and convert HeroBanner to Netflix-style auto-sliding carousel.

fixes: Moved scrollToIndex outside state updater using activeIndexRef pattern
Removed hasTVPreferredFocus from focus trigger (set to false) to avoid competing hints
Added isPlaying state sync from PLAYER_EVENT messages in handleMessage
Added scrollEnabled={!isTV} to FlatList to prevent D-pad focus trap on TV
Improved injected JS: CSS injection for visible controls, periodic mouse-move keep-alive
